structure: A single Markdown ruling file (workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/ruling-ian-2026-11-23.md) from Ian, dated 23 November 2026, answering whether the live animals and high-risk plants party pickers list every address for a role on one page. It opens with the bug report that raised it, quotes inc-087's acceptance criterion 7 under "What was asked", and then rules in seven numbered points under "Decided": the paging figure and the clause dropped, the distillation error identified, the same ruling settling the opposite answer three lines above, the prototype's single page as a fixture, the restatement of the chosen address returning, req-611 left alone, and inc-087 staying done. Scope is the whole file; nothing is left out. It is one part.

parts.title: Whole ruling
parts.scope: The whole file: the bug report quoted at the top, the criterion quoted under "What was asked", and the seven numbered points under "Decided". There is no other part.
covers: What was asked: inc-087 criterion 7's "one page ... however many the role has" clause, built as written, and that both frontends paged at five before inc-087 with nothing recording it

Decided point 1: the pickers page at eight, the one-page clause of criteria 7, 8 and 9 is dropped, eight is the figure the INS address book list already uses, the animals transporter list is not a precedent, and paging sits on top of the role filtering
Decided point 2: the clause was a distillation error resting on a claim that is the orchestrator's application of Sam's principle rather than a ruling of Sam's on paging

Decided point 3: the same ruling builds the INS address book list at eight a page three lines above, so one page of it holds two incompatible answers, and eight is the one with a requirement behind it
Decided point 4: the prototype's single page is a fixture of a book too small to need paging, resting on the look-and-feel claim rather than the data-claims ruling
Decided point 5: the "Selected address" restatement comes back with the paging, between the search box and the results, in the words both frontends already had
Decided point 6: the address book's own role-scoped list stays unpaginated, because each frontend reads the whole book and filters by role itself
Decided point 7: inc-087 stays done, and EUDPA-827 corrects the code, the criteria, the requirements, c-094's outcome and the behaviour spec
Any gap the ruling leaves open on what it touches, recorded as a gap claim
